label: Bible Study
prompt: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away _____ things.
verse: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
note: Tucked into the love chapter — growing up in love means putting childish things away.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right _____, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verse: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
note: God holding your right hand while saying 'fear not' — like a parent crossing a busy street with a child.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been _____: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verse: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
note: Saul's sight returned when something like scales fell from his eyes — the source of the English idiom.

label: Deep Water
prompt: It is a _____ thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verse: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
note: The sobering close to one of Hebrews' sternest warnings — the same hands that save are not to be trifled with.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with _____ living.
verse: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
note: The prodigal 'wasted his substance with riotous living' — the KJV's elegant phrase for blowing it all.
